svg.text: I/O board · 2 · ESP32-S3, USB-C programming, buttons
Sheet 2/7 · planning schematic · not yet in KiCad
All signal nets go to the other sheets by name (sheet number in brackets)
USB-C programming (native USB) with ESD protection
USB_D− / USB_D+ pass a USBLC6-2 ESD protector (U4) right at J1.
Status LED: SK6812-MINI-E (RGB), 5 V supply, data GPIO48 → 330 Ω → DIN, 100 n at VDD.
Strapping pins GPIO0, 3, 45, 46 stay free (GPIO0 only BOOT). GPIO35–37 are usable because the N8 module has no octal PSRAM.
GPIO1–10 are ADC1 (works with Wi-Fi): pressure, grey rods and battery voltage use them.
